body: How to check whether TermAl Central is saving durable state, read-only, without opening the store: read heartbeats in ~/.termal/host-lifecycle.jsonl (kind "heartbeat", every ~60 s). counters.persistTicks and counters.persistFailedTicks are cumulative per instanceId (they reset when the host restarts). If persistFailedTicks rises at about the tick rate, every persist is failing. Incident 2026-11-01: after a UNIQUE(messages.session_id, message_id) transcript failure (session-15589, 01:18Z), persist failed on almost every tick from ~01:39Z (56 → 314 by 01:42Z, instance 48f5a5a5). Symptoms: gated admissions withheld (control_binding_unavailable, durability unknown), test registration refused ("persistence writer failed"), sessions excluded with control_settlement_unconfirmed. While persist is failing, advise NO restart (unsaved state would be lost), no landing or install; run tests in standalone mode. Items: w-8ec0f56d9976 (root) and w-135181fe8685 (recovery hotfix).
